reason: The cited evidence does not support the key premises. E4 shows the CoCrFeNiMo0.85 coating cracked on carbon steel and does not test it in molten salt. E1-E3 study a different HEA (Cr18Mn27Fe27.5Ni27.5) and report Cr-rich precipitation alongside significant mass loss from Mn dissolution, not enhanced corrosion resistance. No evidence links Cr-rich precipitation to improved corrosion protection in the proposed system.
premises: CoCrFeNiMo0.85 HEA coating acts as a corrosion barrier on steel
Precipitation of a Cr-rich second phase enhances corrosion resistance
The coating reduces mass change relative to uncoated Q235 steel
These effects occur in molten FLiBe salt at 700 °C for 1000 hours
